_note: Documented residual advisories. CI fails on any high/critical advisory NOT listed here. Remove an entry once it is actually fixed (never to silence the gate).

baseline.name: next
baseline.reason: 14.2.35 is the latest patched 14.x. Residual range covers 15.x-line issues and self-hosted-only vectors; this deployment runs on Vercel with images.unoptimized (optimizer off). Major migration to Next 15 tracked separately.
baseline.compensating: Vercel hosting (no self-host image optimizer DoS); images.unoptimized:true; server Actions body limit 2mb; middleware fail-open only for session refresh, never authz.

baseline.name: firebase-admin
baseline.reason: Fix requires breaking major 12.x -> 14.x. Used only lazily by the push-notification cron (server-only); RSA/node-forge path not exercised.
baseline.compensating: Lazy server-only import; no client certificate handling; no user-supplied crypto input.

baseline.name: node-forge
baseline.reason: Transitive via firebase-admin; same breaking-major constraint as above.

baseline.name: postcss
baseline.reason: Nested postcss@8.4.31 pinned by next@14.2.35 (top-level is patched 8.5.26). Only fixable via Next 15 major migration.
baseline.compensating: Build-time CSS parser only — parses first-party stylesheets at build, never user input at runtime.
